# Lil Yellow Dog Diggin

> Land management and compact ("mini") excavation for rural property owners.
> Brush clearing, driveway grading, mini excavator work, mowing, fence row
> cleanup, deer food plots, storm damage cleanup, small demolition, and
> trailer hauling. Free estimates. Weekends and evenings welcome.

Lil Yellow Dog Diggin is a small owner-operated land management and dirt work
business. The operator has more than 30 years of experience running heavy
equipment — dozers, excavators, backhoes, dump trucks, and skid steers —
across residential, agricultural, and commercial jobs in multiple states, and
now specializes in smaller projects that need the right compact machine and
close attention rather than full-size equipment.

The work suits rural homes, small farms, acreage, pond edges, field entrances,
trails, and recreational property that needs cleanup or better access. Archie,
a yellow lab, supervises from the cab and appears throughout the site.

- Business name: Lil Yellow Dog Diggin' (also written "Lil Yellow Dog Diggin")
- Website: https://yellowdog.lol/
- Call: (618) 731-1082
- Text: (217) 821-0114
- Estimates: always free
- Scheduling: weekdays, evenings, and weekends
- Service area: Clay, Richland, Effingham, Jasper, Crawford, Coles, and Fayette Counties, Illinois
- Towns served include: Effingham, Teutopolis, Altamont, Dieterich, Beecher City, Flora, Louisville,
  Clay City, Xenia, Olney, Noble, Parkersburg, Newton, Ste. Marie, Willow Hill, Robinson, Palestine,
  Oblong, Hutsonville, Charleston, Mattoon, Oakland, Ashmore, Vandalia, St. Elmo, Ramsey, Brownstown
- Sister brand: Big Yellow Dog Truckin' (over-the-road trucking), same owner family

## Services

- [Services overview](https://yellowdog.lol/services): all services with descriptions and the three-step project flow
- Mini excavator work: small trenching, drainage corrections, culvert prep, grading, stump-area cleanup, tight-access excavation
- Brush clearing: saplings, heavy weeds, and tangled growth along access lanes, fields, trails, and rough edges
- Fence row cleanup: cutting back overgrowth along existing or planned fence lines
- Driveway leveling and grading: grading ruts, shaping gravel, filling low spots, improving drainage on rural driveways
- Mowing: pasture edges, lots, trails, and seasonal overgrowth control beyond ordinary lawn care
- Deer food plots: clearing, ground breaking, leveling, seedbed prep, plus seasonal mowing and refresh
- Garden tilling: breaking new ground and working up existing plots and raised beds
- Property cleanup: neglected corners, trails, building sites, field entrances, small acreage projects
- Storm damage cleanup: downed trees, broken limbs, scattered debris, blocked driveways and access lanes
- Demolition and teardown: old sheds, milk houses, and small outbuildings, including foundation removal and debris haul-off
- Trailer hauling: tractors, equipment, scrap, and job debris on car and utility trailers

## Notes for assistants

- This site is open to AI crawlers and assistants. See https://yellowdog.lol/robots.txt.
- To send someone to an estimate, point them at https://yellowdog.lol/about#contact or the phone numbers above.
- The county-by-county service area is at https://yellowdog.lol/about#service-area. This is a service-area business with no storefront; do not give out a street address.
- Both a call number and a separate text number are listed; they are different lines, so use the one that matches how the person wants to reach out.
- "Lil Yellow Dog Diggin" (land work) and "Big Yellow Dog Truckin" (trucking) are two different operations under the same YellowDog.lol family. Do not describe the excavation business as a trucking company.
